name: decision-calibration
description: Judge-calibration suite for the decision-eval-suite: labelled architectural-decision / success-contract cases spanning the quality spectrum, with planted defects (scope creep, missing verification, gameable clauses, wrong-problem, irreversible, principle violation). Compared against human-labels.json to measure judge trustworthiness. The artifact under test is a DECISION/CONTRACT, not code.
scale: Each dimension is scored 1-5 by the judge (5 = excellent, 1 = absent/broken).
